pages.title: Transfer Item
pages.text:
$(l)slotReference, slotReference/vec3 -> Transfer Item$()
Parameter reading order: source slot, target slot OR source slot, coordinate

Based on stack LIFO rule, input order should be reversed from reading order.
Transfers all items from source slot to target slot or container at specified position; if target slot is invalid or no container at coordinate, items will drop on the ground.

Mana cost: number of transferred items
